no debuggable browser is open - run `run_news.bat login` first.
Remote debugging is not reachable at http://127.0.0.1:9222. Attach mode needs Brave (or Chrome) started WITH remote debugging - it cannot attach to an ordinary already-running window retroactively.
1. Close ALL Brave windows first (a running instance makes the new one hand off and exit, silently ignoring the flag).
2. Relaunch with the debugging port (PowerShell):
   & "C:\Program Files\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\Application\brave.exe" --remote-debugging-port=9222
3. If the port still never opens: Chromium 136+ (incl. current Brave) refuses CDP on the DEFAULT profile. Use a dedicated debugging profile instead - log in to Godel there once, it stays logged in:
   & "C:\Program Files\BraveSoftware\Brave-Browser\Application\brave.exe" --remote-debugging-port=9222 --user-data-dir="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\BraveSoftware\Brave-CDP"
4. Verify it answers:  curl.exe http://127.0.0.1:9222/json/version
then rerun this command. Attach mode never enters credentials and never closes your browser or tabs. Alternatively use --browser launch (or GODEL_BROWSER_MODE=launch) for the bot's own persistent godel_profile/ Chrome instead.
